decisions.reason: As a newly launched sensor module with its own page, it fits the firm's stated platform expansion and management can readily justify weak early sales as temporary.
Because it was launched explicitly as the successor to an earlier generation, the firm is publicly committed to it as part of its ongoing hardware-update path.
The MQTT proxy extends the software side of the modular ecosystem, and recent development effort plus strategic fit make withdrawal unlikely so soon after launch.
A CAN bus interface is well aligned with automation and embedded use cases, though its lower website prominence makes it slightly more vulnerable than the more visibly promoted launches.
This dedicated sensor module broadens the measurement portfolio in a way consistent with the firm's announced direction, encouraging continued support despite any initial disappointment.
The touch panel accessory is somewhat less central than core modules and software, but its recent launch and visible presentation still favor retaining it for now.
